entry.title: llama.cpp b11476 released
entry.summary: metal : few-row MMA mat-mul for the remaining src0 types ( #30065 ) The generic few-row MMA kernel works for any type with a 16-weight dequantizer, so it now also takes BF16, Q1_0, Q2_0, MXFP4, Q2_K, Q3_K, TQ2_0 and the IQ types. Each type starts at the row count where it beats the current kernels on an M3 Ultra: 5 row — Also covered by: ggml-org/whisper.cpp
